newsitem.title: UK: Maxwell may help Mirror find assets - paper.
newsitem.headline: Maxwell may help Mirror find assets - paper.

text.p: Kevin Maxwell may help trustees of Mirror Group Newspapers Plc pension funds in their efforts to recover up to 50 million pounds ($82.01 million) of missing assets, the Times reported on Monday.
"I told them that if I can help, I will," Maxwell was quoted as saying by the newspaper. He was referring to a letter sent to him by the trustees asking him for help in finding the missing assets.

Maxwell is the youngest son of media tycoon Robert Maxwell, whose death in 1991 led to the collapse of his business empire. Hundreds of millions of pounds were found missing from Maxwell company pension funds.
Kevin Maxwell and his brother Ian were acquitted of fraud charges last year.
Advisers to the pension funds believed between 30 million pounds ($49.20 million) and 50 million pounds ($82.01 million) of assets were still missing, the Times said.
